title: 011有我在，别怕！
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“......”

林萧哽咽半天，除却落下两滴泪之外，什么话也不愿说。

那双布满红血丝的眼睛，始终不肯直视李铭烨。

李铭烨懂林萧的性子，于是轻轻捧起她的脸，用拇指擦去眼泪，“不想说就不说了，我带你去吃饭。”

车子启动上路时，风从车窗内挤进来，打在林萧脸上。

她盯着道路旁不断后退的树和人影，心里难受得不行。

脑子里，面试官那张涂满正红色口红，却依旧无法遮盖皱纹的刻薄嘴唇依旧动来动去。

喷出的每一个字，都像是刀子般将林萧刺得遍体鳞伤。

她不想将那些尖酸刻薄的话告诉任何人，怕对方心里也这么认为。

很快，李铭烨将车子停在了一家提前预定好的农家院前。

他拉开车门，朝林萧伸出手，“来，牵着我的手。”

林萧解开安全带卡扣，扫了眼李铭烨的掌心，犹豫片刻之后将手放了上去。

这让李铭烨心中大喜，他默默将手反扣，和林萧十指相扣，一起走进了农家院。

爆炒草鸡，现炸河虾，时蔬拼盘......李铭烨将这家店所有的特色点了一遍。

他单手杵着脸，坐在林萧对面，那双墨色眸子里除了林萧之外再也没有别的东西。

“萧萧，这几天给王姨放假，让你天天吃我煮的东西，真是委屈你了。”

“你知道吗？昨天晚上我自己尝了一下那份蛋炒饭，我...那一瞬间我觉得你好爱我，居然这么包容我的厨艺。”

林萧抬眸，看着李铭烨这幅贬低自己来逗她笑的模样，扣在桌上的手指微微缩了一下。

随后，她扬起下巴深吸一口气，“只是不想浪费食物。”

“嗯，不错。”李铭烨从口袋里摸索几下，随后握住拳头朝林萧伸了过去，“勤俭节约，值得夸奖，这是给你的奖励，不过需要按一下我的手背才能解锁。”

“幼稚。”林萧嘴上吐槽了一句，但还是按照李铭烨的说辞，用食指点了点他的手背。

【哗啦】

瞬间，李铭烨松开拳头，一条SweetAlhambra项链出现在林萧眼前，晃来晃去。

这条项链林萧记了很久，当初两人一同逛街时，她曾驻足多看了好几眼，后来也一直放在购物车里舍不得入手。

Page (1/3)

"..."

Lin Xiao choked with sobs for a long time, unwilling to say anything except for a few tears.

Those red bloodshot eyes still refused to look directly at Li Mingye.

Li Mingye understood Lin Xiao's temperament, so he gently held her face and wiped away the tears with his thumb, "If you don't want to talk, just stop talking. I'll take you to dinner."

When the car started on the road, the wind squeezed in through the window and hit Lin Xiao on the face.

She stared at the receding trees and figures beside the road, feeling extremely uncomfortable.

In my mind, the interviewer's mean lips, covered in red lipstick but still unable to cover the wrinkles, were still moving.

Every word he spat out was like a knife stabbing Lin Xiao all over his body.

She didn't want to tell anyone those harsh words, for fear that the other person would think so.

Soon, Li Mingye parked the car in front of a farmyard that had been booked in advance.

He opened the car door and stretched out his hand towards Lin Xiao, "Come, hold my hand."

Lin Xiao unbuckled his seat belt, glanced at Li Mingye's palm, and put his hand up after hesitating for a moment.

This made Li Mingye feel happy. He silently clasped his hands behind his back, intertwined his fingers with Lin Xiao, and walked into the farmyard together.

Stir-fried grass chicken, freshly fried river shrimp, seasonal vegetable platter... Li Mingye ordered all the specialties of this restaurant.

He held his face with one hand and sat across from Lin Xiao. There was nothing but Lin Xiao in his dark eyes.

"Xiao Xiao, I'm really wronging you by giving Aunt Wang a few days off and asking you to eat what I cook every day."

"You know? I tasted the egg fried rice myself last night, and I...at that moment, I felt that you love me so much, that you are so tolerant of my cooking skills."

Lin Xiao raised his eyes and saw Li Mingye demeaning himself to make her laugh, and his fingers on the table shrank slightly.

Then, she raised her chin and took a deep breath, "I just don't want to waste food."

"Well, not bad." Li Mingye fumbled in his pocket a few times, then held his fist and stretched it towards Lin Xiao, "Thrifty and frugal, it deserves praise. This is a reward for you, but you need to press the back of my hand to unlock it."

"Childish." Lin Xiao complained, but still followed Li Mingye's words and tapped the back of his hand with his index finger.

【Wow】

In an instant, Li Mingye unclenched his fist, and a Sweet Alhambra necklace appeared in front of Lin Xiao, dangling.

Lin Xiao had remembered this necklace for a long time. When they were shopping together, she had stopped to look at it several times, and later she kept it in the shopping cart and was reluctant to buy it.
